text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the Arima Kinen was 
Zenno Rob Roy. She becomes only the 2nd 
Umamusume in history to achieve the 
monumental "Autumn Senior Triple Crown." 
Roars of praise and adulation envelop her 
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S declares: If a hero is 
someone who inspires courage, "Then 
you—are my 'Hero.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy wipes away her tears. Then, 
she thrusts her fist high into the sky. 
Her figure was—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
A hero raising her sword. It was none 
other than that gallant sight.
